role: The 'compass' item icon's animated TextureAtlasSprite: each tick it eases a smoothed needle angle toward the bearing from the player to the world spawn and advances the texture frame.

members.name: TextureCompass
members.note: the sprite comes from the dump

members.name: updateCompass
members.note: the smoothing branch is compass_tick, the set-angle branch RenderItemFrame uses is texanim_compass_frame

notes: Compasses are reachable through villager trades (csrc/engine/trades.c lists item 345). Off-surface the vanilla needle is randomized via the oracle hook netherite.oracle.Det.mathRandom(), the oracle's determinism pin. World.getSpawnPoint server-side state is a separate file's concern.
